description: A null bool for a number parameter that accepts null is an error
notes: The spec's call rules make an argument that doesn't match its parameter's type an error, and bool doesn't match number. But the spec also says automatic conversion is attempted when a value doesn't match what an operation expects, and that every null converts to a null of any other type, regardless of the rules for its type, which would give a null number that the parameter accepts. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments, but go-cty converts a null only when its type converts to the target type (getConversion in cty/convert/conversion.go), so the call fails, as native/types/null-number-or-operand-is-error shows for operators.
